testcase.name: the waypoint pin carries a hollow ring on its head
the feature at the anchor is drawn in the fill colour
the anchor is the bitmap's exact centre, so icon-anchor center puts it on the coordinate
the flag's resize left the find, the waypoint and the photo exactly as they were
the find marker is a mushroom anchored at its stem foot
the padding holds the whole casing, so nothing is clipped
the reticle's arms pass the ring's outer edge
each glyph's fill extent and anchor are the glyph board's
